training_data.name: Emotional Sentiment Analysis
training_data.quote: The dataset includes user inputs, their corresponding emotional states, and tailored chatbot responses generated by the Gemma2 model, formatted for training LLaMA-2 models.

training_data.name: GoEmotions
training_data.quote: The simplified data includes a set of train/val/test splits with 43,410, 5426, and 5427 examples respectively.

training_method.update_scope_quote: Fine-tuned using QLoRA with 4-bit quantization for efficient inference.

description.text:
Emotional_Chatbot is a fine-tuned version of the LLaMA-2-7b-Chat model, specifically designed to create chatbots that can understand and respond empathetically to the emotions expressed by users. This model is tailored for applications in conversational AI, where emotional understanding and context-aware responses are crucial.

Purpose: To generate contextually relevant and empathetic responses to user inputs while understanding the user’s emotional state.

output_type.quote: specifically designed to create chatbots that can understand and respond empathetically to the emotions expressed by users.

use_claim.quote: Mental Health Support Chatbots: Provide empathetic and emotionally sensitive responses to users seeking support.

warning.quote: While the model generates empathetic responses, it is not a substitute for professional mental health or medical advice.

serving.text_only_input_quote: user_input = "I feel sad about not achieving my goals"
serving.notes: tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key, and the repository has no chat_template.jinja. The card example calls pipeline text-generation with max_length 200 and splits the output on [/INST]. It sets model_name to VaisakhKrishna/Emotional_Chatbot; an unauthenticated request for that id returned HTTP 401. generation_config.json has no top_k or max_new_tokens. config.json max_position_embeddings is 4096. The weight index total_size is 13476839424 bytes, float16, with no adapter_config.json. The card does not say whether a LoRA adapter was merged.

evaluation_reported.text: Demonstrates high accuracy in identifying emotional states and generating relevant responses.

discrepancies: Inventory methods, dataset, and parent match the card. config.json _name_or_path is NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf, not meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf.
